title: 被動光網路設備
summary: 以PON 收發機、突發模式與協議封裝串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect pon transceivers, burst modes and protocol framing through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 設備邊界：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「設備邊界」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For equipment boundaries, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「設備邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「光模組規格」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around equipment boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat optics specifications as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 比較「設備邊界」與「光模組規格」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Compare whether evidence for equipment boundaries and optics specifications supports the same inference.
steps.failure: PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「設備邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for equipment boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。
knowledge.textEn: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「光模組規格」：波段、功率級及接收範圍要一同匹配。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「設備邊界」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring optics specifications: Match wavelength, power class and receiving range together. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove equipment boundaries passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 10 Gbit/s 毛速率只有 85% 可給 payload，32 住戶均分理想值為 10×0.85/32=0.265625 Gbit/s；這不是產品額定或公平演算法保證。
knowledge.textEn: With assumed 85% payload efficiency on 10 Gbit/s gross rate, equal sharing by 32 homes gives 0.265625 Gbit/s each; this is not a device rating or scheduler guarantee.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「被動光網路設備」的「設備邊界：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Equipment boundaries: architecture and principle” in “Passive optical-network equipment”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「設備邊界」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of equipment boundaries?
options: OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。
PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。
只檢查「光模組規格」，便可取代「設備邊界」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities.
PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data.
Checking optics specifications alone replaces verification specific to equipment boundaries.
quiz.explanation: OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。 相鄰的「光模組規格」有不同責任：波段、功率級及接收範圍要一同匹配。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities. Neighboring optics specifications has a different role: Match wavelength, power class and receiving range together. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 設備邊界：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Equipment boundaries: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「設備邊界」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For equipment boundaries, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「OLT 與 ONT 擁有不同的發送及接收責任。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「光模組規格」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: OLTs and ONTs have different transmission/reception responsibilities. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from optics specifications to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 比較「設備邊界」與「光模組規格」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Compare whether evidence for equipment boundaries and optics specifications supports the same inference.
steps.failure: PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「設備邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for equipment boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「突發接收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：不同 ONT 到達功率變化要求快速接收調整。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「前導碼」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around burst reception, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Varying ONT arrival power requires rapid receiver adjustment. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat preambles as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 改單一 ONT 光功率，觀察突發動態範圍。 比較「突發接收」與「前導碼」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Vary one ONT power and observe burst dynamic range. Compare whether evidence for burst reception and preambles supports the same inference.
steps.failure: PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「突發接收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for burst reception. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「前導碼」：前導碼讓接收器取得時鐘及突發邊界。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「突發接收」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring preambles: Preambles establish clock recovery and burst boundaries. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove burst reception passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

options: PON 接收端只需處理連續同功率資料。
只檢查「前導碼」，便可取代「突發接收」的專屬驗證。
不同 ONT 到達功率變化要求快速接收調整。
optionsEn: PON receivers only handle continuous constant-power data.
Checking preambles alone replaces verification specific to burst reception.
Varying ONT arrival power requires rapid receiver adjustment.
